Transcriber.call:
tr = transcriber.transcribe(input_path)
    text = tr.enhanced_transcript or tr.raw_transcript

options.name: enhanced_transcript
options.effect: Two-pass transcript enhancement; internally constructs TranscriptEnhancer (Finnish-tuned). For audio input, prefer this over adding a separate TranscriptEnhancer step.
options.infer_from: language == 'fi' (Finnish). For other languages enhancement needs prompt customisation; default off and flag to the user.

options.name: language
options.effect: ISO 639-1 language code (or 'auto').
options.infer_from: technical_spec.language

options.name: diarization
options.effect: Speaker diarization (who spoke when).
options.infer_from: requirement mentions multiple speakers / meetings / interviews

options.name: speaker_count
options.effect: Exact number of speakers for diarization (passed to whisper_local).
options.infer_from: diarization == true AND speaker count is known from requirements -> ask the user for the exact number

options.name: min_speakers
options.effect: Minimum speaker count hint for diarization when exact count is unknown.
options.infer_from: diarization == true AND speaker count is a range rather than a fixed number

options.name: max_speakers
options.effect: Maximum speaker count hint for diarization when exact count is unknown.
options.infer_from: diarization == true AND speaker count is a range rather than a fixed number

options.name: enhanced_transcript_instructions
options.effect: Extra correction instructions forwarded to the internal TranscriptEnhancer (Pass 2). Use to inject domain vocabulary, abbreviations, or proper nouns.
options.infer_from: enhanced_transcript == true AND domain_vocabulary or domain-specific terminology is present

options.name: default_prompt
options.default: Detect the language and extract transcript in the same language.
options.effect: Whisper transcription prompt prepended before custom_context. Override to bias the model toward domain terminology.
options.infer_from: domain_vocabulary is provided OR source language is known in advance and not auto-detected correctly

options.name: initial_prompt
options.effect: Whisper initial_prompt hint (whisper_local only). Seeds the decoder with domain terminology to reduce ASR errors.
options.infer_from: transcription_model == whisper_local AND domain_vocabulary is present

options.name: output_dir
options.effect: Directory where intermediate workspace files are written.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - set only when a custom workspace path is needed

options.name: max_size_mb
options.effect: File-size threshold in MB above which audio is chunked before transcription.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave default unless the API provider has a different size limit

options.name: max_duration_seconds
options.effect: Duration threshold in seconds above which audio is chunked before transcription.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave default unless the API provider has a different duration limit

options.name: additional_instructions
options.effect: Domain-specific correction instructions.
options.infer_from: domain_vocabulary

options.name: domain_rules
options.effect: Domain-specific override rules injected into both enhancement passes (Pass 1 and Pass 2 system prompts). Takes precedence over general rules where stated. Use to enforce domain spelling, abbreviations, or proper nouns.
options.infer_from: domain_vocabulary or domain-specific terminology is present (distinct from additional_instructions which only applies to Pass 2)

options.name: generate_summary
options.effect: Appends a CorrectionSummary (total_changes, insertions, deletions, substitutions) to the result for auditing how many tokens were changed.
options.infer_from: human_review == yes OR audit trail of corrections is required

options.name: diff_chunks
options.effect: Populates result.diff_chunks with a token-level diff between the original and enhanced text; useful for review UIs.
options.infer_from: human_review == yes AND a diff view is needed in the integration target

TranscriptEnhancer.note: Finnish-tuned. When the input is audio, do NOT add this as a separate step -- set Transcriber(enhanced_transcript=True) instead, which calls this internally. Use this standalone only to enhance an already-existing transcript (text input).

options.name: save_json

Extractor.import: from gaik.software_components.extractor import SchemaGenerator, DataExtractor, get_openai_config
Extractor.construct:

    schema_gen = SchemaGenerator(config=config)

Extractor.call:
schema, requirements = _load_output_schema(schema_dir)
    if schema is None:
        schema = schema_gen.generate_schema(user_requirements=user_requirements)
        requirements = schema_gen.item_requirements
        schema_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        _save_output_schema(schema_gen, schema, requirements, schema_dir)
    extracted_fields = extractor.extract(extraction_model=schema, requirements=requirements, user_requirements=user_requirements, documents=[source_text])
Extractor.note: Use _load_output_schema() first. Schema files are always named output_schema.* regardless of blueprint schema_name.

options.name: include_verification
options.effect: Per-field confidence + reasoning, useful before human review.
options.infer_from: human_review == yes OR target_output_spec.confidence_required

options.name: model_provider
options.effect: Vision LLM provider.
options.infer_from: technical_spec.model_provider

options.name: merge_table
options.effect: Merge table data into the extracted text.
options.infer_from: inputs contain tables

options.name: additional_instructions
options.effect: Extra text appended to the user extraction prompt. Use to inject domain-specific rules, field-level hints, or language directives without replacing the built-in prompt.
options.infer_from: domain_vocabulary OR special extraction rules exist -> encode as additional_instructions; leave null for standard extraction

options.name: model_provider
options.effect: Parsing LLM provider.
options.infer_from: technical_spec.model_provider

options.name: merge_table
options.effect: Merge tables into the markdown text.
options.infer_from: inputs contain tables

options.name: additional_instructions
options.effect: Extra text appended to the user prompt for every parse call. Use to inject domain-specific formatting rules, language hints, or field-focus instructions without replacing the built-in prompt.
options.infer_from: domain_vocabulary OR special output formatting requirements; leave null unless the user specifies extra parsing guidance

options.name: create_html
options.effect: When True, also renders the cleaned markdown into a standalone styled HTML document and exposes it as ParseResult.html.
options.infer_from: output_types include html OR integration_target is a web UI that consumes HTML

options.name: custom_prompt
options.effect: Overrides the built-in page-conversion prompt. When set, the supplied text replaces the default 'Convert this document page to accurate markdown' instruction sent to the vision model.
options.infer_from: domain_vocabulary OR special formatting requirements -> ask for a custom extraction prompt

options.name: use_context
options.effect: When True, feeds the tail of the previous page's markdown to the model so that tables and sections that span page boundaries are continued seamlessly.
options.infer_from: multi-page documents with cross-page tables; leave True (default) unless a single-page document

options.name: dpi
options.effect: PDF-to-image rendering resolution passed to PyMuPDF. Higher DPI improves OCR quality on dense or small-font pages at the cost of larger images and higher token usage.
options.infer_from: inputs are low-DPI scans OR small-font dense documents -> suggest raising to 300

options.name: clean_output
options.effect: When True and the PDF has more than one page, runs a second LLM call to merge and clean the per-page markdown outputs into a single coherent document.
options.infer_from: single-page documents only -> set False to avoid the extra LLM call; otherwise leave True

options.name: use_markdown
options.effect: When True, extracts plain text concatenated page by page. When False, extracts structured text annotated with (x, y) bounding-box coordinates for each text span - useful for layout-sensitive downstream processing.
options.infer_from: downstream needs positional/layout data -> False; otherwise leave True

options.name: use_markdown
options.effect: When True, extracts plain paragraph and table text. When False, emits a structured representation with paragraph-index, style-name, and table-cell markers - useful for style-aware downstream processing.
options.infer_from: downstream needs paragraph style / formatting metadata -> False; otherwise leave True

options.name: enable_ocr
options.effect: OCR for scanned / image-based PDFs.
options.infer_from: inputs are scanned or image-based PDFs

options.name: enable_table_structure
options.effect: Extract table structure.
options.infer_from: inputs contain tables

options.name: enable_formula_enrichment
options.effect: Runs Docling's formula/equation enrichment pipeline to detect and render mathematical notation. Adds processing time; safe to disable for documents without formulas.
options.infer_from: input documents contain mathematical formulas or scientific notation -> keep True; otherwise set False to reduce latency

options.name: ocr_engine
options.effect: Selects the OCR backend when enable_ocr=True. Options: 'rapidocr' (no system deps), 'tesseract_cli' / 'tesseract' (system Tesseract required), 'easyocr' (GPU-friendly). Affects language support, accuracy, and system dependencies.
options.infer_from: enable_ocr == true AND (non-Latin script OR language != 'en') -> prefer easyocr or tesseract; default rapidocr works for Latin-script documents with no system deps

options.name: use_markdown
options.effect: When True, exports the parsed document as markdown (including embedded images). When False, uses Docling's structured-text export which preserves more layout metadata but is less readable.
options.infer_from: downstream component expects raw markdown -> True (default); downstream needs structured positional data -> False

options.name: parser
options.effect: Force a specific parser instead of auto-detecting by file extension. Options: 'pymupdf' (text PDFs), 'docx' (Word), 'vision' (images and scanned PDFs). When None, the classifier auto-selects based on file type.
options.infer_from: input_formats: scanned or image-based PDFs require 'vision'; auto-detection is correct for mixed batches

options.name: model_provider
options.effect: Judge LLM provider; using a provider different from the extractor reduces shared-model bias.
options.infer_from: technical_spec.model_provider

options.name: max_tokens
options.effect: Upper bound on the judge response length in tokens. Increase for rubrics with many fields; decrease to cap cost on simple binary checks.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave default unless the rubric is very large or you need to cap cost

options.name: judges
options.effect: Two or more judges; diverse providers give the strongest debiasing via majority vote.
options.infer_from: high-stakes validation that warrants more than one judge

options.name: language
options.effect: Spoken language; controls the pronunciation instruction injected into the synthesis request. Supported: 'fi' (Finnish), 'en' (English).
options.infer_from: technical_spec.language or output language requirement

options.name: voice
options.effect: TTS voice name (provider-specific). The default 'marin' is a Finnish-optimised voice. Change when a different persona or language accent is required.
options.infer_from: persona, brand voice, or language accent requirement is stated

options.name: response_format
options.effect: Audio output format. Supported: mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm. Choose based on integration target codec requirements.
options.infer_from: integration_target audio codec requirement (e.g., browser streaming -> mp3/opus; telephony -> wav/pcm)

options.name: speed
options.effect: Playback speed multiplier for the synthesized audio (e.g., 0.9 for slower, 1.2 for faster).
options.infer_from: accessibility or pacing requirement - leave default unless the user specifies a speed preference

options.name: default_instructions
options.effect: Persistent speaking-style or persona instructions prepended to every synthesis call (e.g., 'Speak in a calm, professional tone.').
options.infer_from: brand voice, tone, or consistent persona is required across all synthesized audio

PostgresAgent.call:
with agent:
        ar = agent.ask(user_query)
    answer = ar.answer

options.name: table_allowlist
options.effect: Restrict which tables the agent may query (security).
options.infer_from: security_constraints / access controls

options.name: answer_language
options.effect: Language of the natural-language answer.
options.infer_from: technical_spec.language

options.name: max_retries
options.effect: Number of agentic-loop attempts when SQL generation or execution fails. Increase for complex queries; set to 1 for fail-fast behaviour.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave default; increase if queries are consistently complex

options.name: max_rows
options.effect: Hard cap on rows returned by run_sql. Prevents large result sets from flooding the LLM context window.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave default; reduce for token-budget-sensitive deployments

options.name: statement_timeout_ms
options.effect: PostgreSQL per-statement timeout in milliseconds (0 disables). Guards against slow or unindexed queries.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave default; reduce for interactive apps that require fast responses

options.name: schema_name
options.effect: The PostgreSQL schema (search_path) the agent operates on. Change when tables live in a non-default schema.
options.infer_from: database has tables in a non-public schema -> ask for the schema name; otherwise leave 'public'

options.name: extra_instructions
options.effect: Free-form text appended to the SQL-generation prompt. Use for a domain glossary, naming conventions, or example question-to-SQL pairs to improve query accuracy.
options.infer_from: domain has non-obvious naming conventions or abbreviations, or the user supplies example queries -> encode as extra_instructions

options.name: match_mode
options.effect: Field comparison mode; 'semantic' needs a judge for free-text fields.
options.infer_from: free-text fields needing semantic (not exact) matching

options.name: case_insensitive
options.effect: When True, exact string comparisons fold case (e.g. 'Yes' == 'yes'). Set False only when case is semantically significant in the extracted fields.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave True (default) unless case matters for the extraction domain

options.name: strip_whitespace
options.effect: When True, leading/trailing whitespace is stripped before exact comparison. Prevents spurious mismatches from OCR or model spacing artifacts.
options.infer_from: technical plumbing - leave True (default)

options.name: skip_context_recall
options.effect: Skip the context-recall metric when no ground truth is available.
options.infer_from: ground-truth availability

options.name: on_error
options.effect: Whether to skip dataset items that raise during the pipeline run.
options.infer_from: dataset robustness needs

RAGWorkflow.construct: workflow = RAGWorkflow(use_azure=use_azure, persist=True, persist_path=str(output_dir / 'chroma_store'), citations=True, stream=False)

options.name: citations
options.effect: Include source citations in the answer.
options.infer_from: traceability / citation requirement

options.name: retriever_top_k
options.effect: Number of chunks retrieved.
options.infer_from: answer breadth requirement

options.name: retriever_hybrid
options.effect: Enables hybrid BM25 + vector search in the Retriever. Improves recall when queries mix exact terms (codes, IDs, names) with conceptual questions.
options.infer_from: queries mix exact keyword terms (product codes, names, IDs) with conceptual or semantic questions

options.name: retriever_rerank
options.effect: Enables cross-encoder re-ranking of retrieved chunks for higher retrieval precision. Adds one extra inference pass per query.
options.infer_from: retrieval precision is critical OR accuracy_critical == yes

options.name: conversation_history
options.effect: Maintains the last `last_n` Q/A pairs as context for subsequent questions. Enables follow-up questions but increases prompt size.
options.infer_from: multi-turn chat / conversational interface required; set false for single-shot batch Q&A

options.name: stream
options.effect: Stream answer tokens from the AnswerGenerator instead of waiting for the full response.
options.infer_from: runtime_interface: interactive/chat UI -> true; batch pipeline or API -> false

options.name: last_n
options.effect: Number of Q/A pairs retained in conversation history when conversation_history=True.
options.infer_from: conversation_history == true; leave default unless the user specifies a context window budget

options.name: retriever_threshold
options.effect: Minimum similarity score for a chunk to be included in results. Filters out low-relevance chunks; None means no threshold.
options.infer_from: technical tuning; leave None unless retrieval returns too many low-relevance results

options.name: persist
options.effect: When true, uses a persistent Chroma vector store at persist_path. When false, the store is in-memory only and lost after the process exits.
options.infer_from: always true for production use; set false only for ephemeral tests or demos

RAGWorkflow.note: End-to-end module: embeds, stores, retrieves, and answers. Do NOT also add Embedder / PgVectorStore / Retriever / AnswerGenerator as separate steps.

ParallelTranscriber.import:
from gaik.software_components.parallel_transcriber import ParallelTranscriber, TranscriptionConfig
    from gaik.software_components.config import get_openai_config

options.name: response_format
options.effect: Output format; 'srt'/'vtt' give timestamped subtitles, 'text' plain transcript.
options.infer_from: output_types: subtitles/captions -> srt or vtt; plain transcript -> text

options.name: model
options.effect: whisper (faster) or gpt-4o-transcribe / diarize backend.
options.infer_from: technical_spec.model; diarization need -> gpt-4o diarize

options.name: chunk_duration_minutes
options.effect: Nominal chunk length for parallel splitting.
options.infer_from: leave default unless the user tunes throughput

options.name: language
options.effect: ISO 639-1 language code passed to Whisper (e.g., 'fi', 'en'). None means auto-detect. Setting explicitly improves accuracy when the language is known.
options.infer_from: technical_spec.language - set when source language is known and not mixed

options.name: prompt
options.effect: Optional Whisper prompt to bias the decoder toward domain vocabulary or proper nouns.
options.infer_from: domain_vocabulary is present - provide key terms to reduce ASR errors

ParallelTranscriber.note: FFmpeg + ffprobe must be on PATH. Use this instead of Transcriber for long media or when fast parallel throughput matters; it does not do Finnish enhancement (no enhanced_transcript option).

MultiSourceReportGenerator.call:
result = generator.run(
    input_paths=input_paths,
    sections=[
        {"id": "findings", "title": "Findings", "instructions": "Describe key findings from the evidence."},
        {"id": "recommendations", "title": "Recommendations", "instructions": "Give recommendations.", "depends_on": ["findings"]}
    ],
    report_title=report_title,
    report_description=report_description,
    report_language=report_language,
    sample_report_path=sample_report_path,
    output_dir=output_dir,
    output_docx=False,
    agentic=True,
    curate_evidence=False,
    polish=False,
    writer_options={"model": "gpt-5.4"}
)
    report_markdown = result.markdown
    written_sections = [s.title for s in result.sections]
    docx_path = result.docx_path

options.name: agentic
options.effect: When true, each section is drafted independently, fact-checked, and repaired by a diff-editor reviewer before the report is assembled. Higher accuracy; more API calls. Requires the multi-source-report-generator-agentic extra (langgraph).
options.infer_from: accuracy_critical == yes OR multi_section_hierarchical_report OR formal_client_facing_report

options.name: report_description
options.effect: Short description of the report's purpose and audience; passed as shared context to the writer, reviewer, and polish pass to keep tone and focus consistent.
options.infer_from: report purpose or audience is known from requirements

options.name: parser_choice
options.effect: Which PDF parser the module uses internally to normalize documents.
options.infer_from: input_formats: text PDF -> auto/pymupdf; scanned/visual PDF -> vision/docling

options.name: sample_report_path
options.effect: Path to a sample report whose structure, style, and tone the output should follow. Content is still drawn only from the evidence. In agentic mode the sample is split by ## headings and matched per section.
options.infer_from: user supplies an example or target report format

options.name: report_language
options.effect: Language to write the report in (e.g. 'English', 'Finnish').
options.infer_from: technical_spec.language

options.name: curate_evidence
options.effect: Agentic mode only. When true, a per-section LLM call extracts a focused evidence brief before drafting, improving relevance for reports with large evidence packs.
options.infer_from: agentic == true AND (large_evidence_pack OR many_sections)

options.name: polish
options.effect: Agentic mode only. Runs a final style and proofreading pass after the mandatory reviewer repair.
options.infer_from: agentic == true AND high_quality_output_required

options.name: output_docx
options.effect: Also write report.docx alongside report.md. Requires the multi-source-report-generator-docx extra and the Pandoc system binary.
options.infer_from: output_format == word OR user requests .docx

options.name: strict_review
options.effect: Agentic mode only. When true, raises before writing any output if the diff-editor reviewer has unresolved edits after retries. Use when the report must never be persisted with unresolved reviewer corrections.
options.infer_from: agentic == true AND (human_review == yes OR accuracy_critical)

options.name: review_options
options.effect: Agentic mode only. LLM config dict for the reviewer pass (same shape as writer_options). When None, the reviewer reuses the writer model/config.
options.infer_from: user specifies a separate or stronger model for fact-checking

options.name: include_source_references
options.effect: When true, the writer cites source filenames inline. Automatically suppressed when only one input source is provided.
options.infer_from: citation or traceability requirement; set false when citations are undesirable in the output

options.name: section_context_mode
options.effect: Controls what evidence context each section writer receives. Currently only all_evidence is supported.
options.infer_from: reserved for future use

options.name: verbose
options.effect: When true, prints per-section progress messages to the console during an agentic run: evidence loading, optional curation, drafting, reviewer corrections applied, and polish pass. Has no effect in single-call mode.
options.infer_from: agentic == true -> always set true in PoC so the user can see the per-section workflow at the CLI

options.name: writer_options
options.effect: LLM config dict for the report writer. Key: 'model' (e.g. 'gpt-5.4'). When None, the module uses its default model. Passed to every section-writing LLM call in both single-call and agentic mode.
options.infer_from: user specifies a writing/extraction model -> set writer_options={'model': '<model>'}

options.name: transcriber_options
options.effect: Options passed to the internal Transcriber when audio/video files are among the inputs. Common keys: 'model' (transcription model, e.g. 'gpt-4o-transcribe'), 'language' (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'fi'), 'enhanced_transcript' (bool, Finnish two-pass enhancement). When None, the Transcriber uses its own defaults.
options.infer_from: input contains audio/video -> always set; model: 'gpt-4o-transcribe' for standard use; language: infer from technical_spec.language; enhanced_transcript: true for Finnish audio

options.name: report_title
options.effect: Title placed at the top of the generated report and DOCX file.
options.infer_from: report type and customer name are known -> set a descriptive title (e.g. 'AI Consultancy Report')

options.name: include_evidence_index
options.effect: When true, writes an evidence_index.json alongside the report listing every source file processed. Useful for audit trails; set false to suppress.
options.infer_from: audit trail or source-traceability requirement -> leave true; suppress only if explicitly unwanted

options.name: max_evidence_chars
options.effect: Hard cap on the total character length of the assembled evidence pack passed to the writer. Prevents context-window overflows for very large source sets. When None, the full evidence is used.
options.infer_from: very large source set (many files or long documents) that risks exceeding the model's context window -> set a limit (e.g. 200000)

options.name: parser_options
options.effect: Advanced options passed through to the selected PDF/document parser (e.g. DoclingParser OCR settings). Most use cases do not need this; leave null unless the chosen parser_choice requires specific configuration.
options.infer_from: parser_choice is set to a non-default value AND the parser requires additional configuration

options.name: image_options
options.effect: Options passed to the internal vision/image handler when image files are among the inputs. Key: 'model' (vision model override). When None, the module uses its default vision model.
options.infer_from: input contains standalone image files AND user specifies a preferred vision model

MultiSourceReportGenerator.note: End-to-end report synthesis module: parses/transcribes/extracts every source file itself and writes the full report. Do NOT add parsers, Transcriber, or VisionExtractor as separate steps. Provide input_paths + sections (each with title, instructions, optional id and depends_on). Sections with depends_on are written after their dependencies in agentic mode, receiving finalized dependency content as context. Use save_report_config/load_report_config to persist and reuse use-case configurations. Install multi-source-report-generator-agentic for agentic mode; multi-source-report-generator-docx for DOCX export.
